name: smwmusic-the-village-at-the-end-of-time
title: The Village at the End of Time
description:
An extremely emotional and moving piece, The Village at the End of Time, is an RPG-esque 'story-telling' song taking you through the life of a small, growing village, going through various crises and coming out of them more powerful than ever, striving for peace across the now reformed village society and the land as a whole.

This incredible piece was composed by the lovely icrawfish and ported by yours truly for the Super Famicompo 5 contests 'Originals' category, which ended up winning 1st place!

I cannot even begin to explain how much fun this whole project was. From beginning to end, it was a joy to work with icrawfish for yet another absolute masterpiece. I hope you enjoy it and stay tuned for next SFC!

P.S.: The song doesn't loop. =P
